message.content:
A magazine cover features a large red masthead "TEMPO" across the top. Below this, the words "ENAK DIBACA DAN PERLU" appear in red. In the top left, text reads "GERILYA MELOLOSKAN UU ANTITERORISME". To the right, text reads "LOBI SAWIT JALUR VATIKAN". 

A central headline in bold black letters reads "INVESTIGASI PAHAM RADIKAL DI KAMPUS KITA". Below this is a paragraph beginning with "WAWANCARA KHUSUS DENGAN MAHASISWI...". The bottom right contains a barcode, price, and date "28 MEI-3 JUNI 2018".

The illustration shows a person in graduation regalia, including a dark blue gown, mortarboard with a yellow tassel, and pink high heels. They walk to the right, holding a rolled diploma. Their long shadow extends behind them to the left. Rising from within this solid black shadow is the upper body of a person wearing a dark face mask, a headscarf, and a tactical vest. This figure emerges from an opening shaped like stairs within the shadow's surface, reaching one hand toward the ground. The background is a light grey.
